players.product: Memory burn-in sorters, test handlers and memory-module test handlers

connects_to.relationship: burn-in sorters and test handlers for memory back-end test

contracts.signal: Supply contract disclosed 10-16-2026 with Micron Semiconductor Technology India Private Limited (SEZ Unit), main business semiconductor manufacturing, for Sorter: KRW 5,675,664,000 (fixed amount, non-conditional), 14.79% of 2025 consolidated revenue (KRW 38,378,522,208); the amount is US$4,240,000 converted at the first base rate of 10-15-2026 (KRW 1338.60/USD). Supply region India; own production; term 10-15-2026 to 03-22-2027 (the end date may change with the customer's circumstances and inspection schedule); the start date and contract date are the day the purchase order was received from the customer. No down payment; payment 90% after delivery and 10% after inspection. The filing marks the counterparty as having performed similar contracts with the company in the last three years.
